yf9e0e79e3de.add: - **Deepest of the marginal seas asked (UPPCS 2015):** **South China Sea** (~5,560 m) > Mediterranean (~5,267 m, Calypso Deep) > Bering (~4,150 m) > Sea of Japan (~3,740 m).

y4f246d4ab94.add: - **Persian Gulf states:** Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, UAE (+ Oman only through the **Musandam** exclave at Hormuz); Oman's main coast is on the **Gulf of Oman and Arabian Sea** – the usual answer to 'not on the Persian Gulf'.

y318439258c8.add: - **Lakes on the Suez Canal** (Port Said → Suez): Manzala, **Timsah**, **Great and Little Bitter Lakes**; **Gatun Lake** belongs to the **Panama** Canal.

y42af162a190.add: - **Ludwig Canal:** old inland waterway of **southern Germany (Bavaria)**, Danube–Main; succeeded by the **Rhine–Main–Danube Canal**.

ycb32b11eb8c.add: - **Malacca littoral states:** **Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore** (Thailand at the northern mouth).

ydad2a109416.add: - **Kyushu:** southern main island of Japan – **Nagasaki** (A-bomb, 9 Aug 1945), Fukuoka; Hiroshima is on Honshu.

y71f89dc7766.add: - **Bougainville:** autonomous region of **Papua New Guinea**; voted ~98% for independence (Nov–Dec 2019, non-binding); PNG parliament still to ratify (as of 2026; target 2027–30).

y88302e0066a.add: - **Hong Kong:** Kowloon **peninsula** + New Territories + Hong Kong Island and **~236 (now 260+) islands**; returned to China 1997.

y2ac5fb0b8d3.add: - **Senkaku / Diaoyu Islands:** uninhabited, **East China Sea**; Japan administers, **China** (and Taiwan) claim them (UPSC 2022).

yba7a42890f5.add: - **Caribbean islands:** Grenada ('Island of Spice'), Montserrat, Anguilla (Lesser Antilles); **Madeira** and the Canaries are in the **Atlantic** off Africa.

ye8db0dfb3ae.add: - **Borneo:** shared by **Indonesia, Malaysia, Brunei**; a **tectonic (accreted) block on the Sunda Shelf, not volcanic** – unlike volcanic Java and Sumatra (UPPCS 2022).

y27d80cacb1f.add: - **Grenada:** island nation in the **south-eastern Caribbean** ('Island of Spice').

y6fd3b82695c.add: - **Tribes and places:** **Koryak – Russian Far East** (not Alaska: Eskimo/Inuit); **Dayak – Borneo**; Bedouin – Arabian desert; **Lapp/Sami – Norway, Sweden, Finland**.

y67cd601099e.add: - **Indonesia W → E:** **Sumatra, Java, Bali, Lombok** (Lesser Sundas continue Sumbawa, Flores, Timor).

yd5a8e42bea4.add: - **Socotra (Yemen):** UNESCO natural World Heritage Site (**2008**), dragon's blood trees.

yde16f6ed6cf.add: - **Indonesia:** world's largest archipelago, **~17,500 islands** (14,000 in older books), from **Aceh** (Sumatra) to the **Torres Strait**; Philippines ~7,600.

ye6d6e332b81.add: - **Most islands:** **Indonesia** (~17,500) > Philippines (~7,600) among the usual options; counting islets, **Sweden** (~2.2 lakh).

ya7f6b8480d1.add: - **Angel Falls:** 979 m = **3,212 ft** (807 m single drop), Churun river, Venezuela.

y4373dff83e3.add: - **Tallest indoor waterfall:** **Rain Vortex**, Jewel **Changi** Airport, **Singapore** (40 m/131 ft, opened 2019).

yf7794b64a37.add: - **Wular:** foot of **Haramukh**, fed by the **Jhelum**, man-made island **Zaina Lank** (Sultan Zain-ul-Abidin, 15th c.).

y8a7ebcf1f52.add: - **Lake → state:** **Anchar** – J&K; **Phulhar** – Pilibhit, UP; Hamirsar – Gujarat (Bhuj); **Chapanala** – Assam; Nakki – Rajasthan (Mt Abu); Lonar – Maharashtra; **Vembanad** – Kerala.

y265a33c306e.add: - **Sudarshan lake:** Mauryan reservoir at **Girnar (Gujarat)**, Pushyagupta; repaired by Rudradaman, Skandagupta.

y8be08ff783a.add: - **Sambhar:** largest inland salt lake, nearest city **Jaipur** (~80 km west).

y2f3612467a9.add: - **Baikal (31,500 sq km)** is just larger than **Great Bear (~31,150)**: Superior > Victoria > Baikal > Great Bear.
